shared.state: Exclusive exact-union|null controlled value or mount-only defaultValue. Controlled owner authoritative; release retains latest committed. No synthetic form fields; native reset does not change tab selection.
shared.keyboard: Default axis comes from each original:14horizontal,15–17vertical. Caller may override either axis, dir and loop. Automatic focus activation or manual arrows-only+Enter/Space activation; Home/End span all eligible items (all8 in14). Native Tab. Actual disabled/fieldset/CSS/hidden/inert/closed containers skipped, composition/modifiers ignored.
shared.lifecycle: Hidden associated panel shells persist, inactive content including action buttons unmounts. Conditional return from a closing focused panel/action only if still hidden and no explicit external focus. Reopened panel invalidates stale return; return focus never proposes a selection. Root/list/tab/panel/action React19 cleanup refs supported.
shared.cancellation: Selection trigger handlers/ancestors and onValueChange event.preventDefault/cancel/false can veto, with owner epoch captured before user handler. New owner/config/disable/unmount wins; descriptor restoration uses unchanged30 observation leases.
shared.actionAPI: Only16/17 expose per-value actionProps and onAction(action,details). details has exact id/value, original MouseEvent and button. Native actionProps.onClick runs synchronously; only after propagation does onAction notify an uncanceled, still-connected, still-current-owner intent. Snapshot epoch before user handler. Root disabled or per-action disabled suppresses intent. Per-tab disabled affects navigation only, not independent active-panel actions.
shared.actionBoundary: onAction is a local intent notification, not a default operation or owner setter. It has no boolean/cancel return contract; return values are ignored. Native handler/ancestor preventDefault can prevent notification before dispatch. Callback itself may choose whether to update an application receipt. No built-in network/deployment/booking/profile navigation, no artificial async success, no focus moved by action dispatch. Example parent shows accepted/refused local receipts.
shared.actionKeyboard: Actions retain native button Enter/Space/Tab semantics; no synthetic button keyboard activation layer. JSDOM action-click models are not trusted native-keyboard acceptance. Buttons never submit a host form.
shared.a11y: Unique reciprocal tab/panel IDs and roving tabindex, exact visible names with decorative local SVGs. Action names retained; caller attributes/ref allowed while fixed text/type/id/role protected.
shared.style: Distinct scoped structures,17 complete panels total, responsive overflow/layout, reduced motion and forced-color rules. Reuse unchanged thirtieth owner/availability code, no new tooltip.
